$schema.description: The JSON schema for this file.

host.description: The PostHog host for this project, like https://eu.posthog.com. `hog auth login` uses it, and other commands stop when your credentials are for another host. --host and HOG_HOST override it.

release.description: The release every uploaded symbol set belongs to.

name.description: The release name, usually the app or service name.

version.description: The release version. hog uses the git commit when this is not set.

releaseMode.description: JavaScript only: put the release in the bundle (event, the default) or in the symbol set. --release-mode and HOG_RELEASE_MODE override it.

sources.description: What `hog error-tracking inject`, `upload` and `process` scan when no path is passed.

path.description: A folder or file to scan, relative to posthog.json.

kind.description: The artifact type. hog detects it from the files when this is not set.

ignore.description: Glob patterns of files to skip, relative to `path`.

mapId.description: ProGuard only: the map ID your Android build injected into the app.

items.description: A place where the build writes artifacts with symbols, such as bundles and their sourcemaps.

cli.description: Defaults for global options. Flags and HOG_ environment variables override them.

noFail.description: Exit with code 0 when a command fails, like --no-fail. HOG_NO_FAIL overrides it.

telemetry.description: false stops hog from sending anonymous usage data to PostHog for everyone working in this folder.

rateLimit.description: The most requests hog sends per minute, like --rate-limit. HOG_RATE_LIMIT overrides it.

dir.description: The folder of endpoint YAML files, relative to posthog.json. `hog endpoints pull` writes there, and `push` and `diff` read it when no path is passed.

languages.description: The typed SDKs `hog schema pull` generates, by language. posthog-cli reads the same entries.

output_path.description: Where the generated module goes, relative to posthog.json.

schema_hash.description: The hash of the event definitions the module was generated from.

updated_at.description: When the module was last generated.

event_count.description: How many events the module types.

additionalProperties.description: One generated SDK. `hog schema pull` writes it.

description: Settings for the PostHog CLI. Never put API keys here: use `hog auth login` or environment variables.
